## The Pantanal, Bonito, Lençóis Maranhenses and São Luís

The Pantanal covers a vast wetland in the heart of South America. Rivers and lakes lie alongside grasslands and dense vegetation. You can explore by boat, on horseback, on foot and on a four-wheel-drive safari. The programme includes piranha fishing, birdwatching and a night drive to areas where caimans are found.

Bonito is known for its clear waters and abundant aquatic life. This part of the itinerary includes waterfalls, the Blue Grotto and snorkelling in the Sucuri River, where the clear water lets you see fish and aquatic plants directly beneath you.

The landscape changes completely in Lençóis Maranhenses, where white sand dunes alternate with blue and green lagoons fed by rainwater. You can climb the dunes, swim and take in the broad sweep of the park from above.

The journey ends in São Luís, where you’ll see a different side of Brazil. Buildings from the 17th and 18th centuries survive in the historic centre, and many façades are decorated with Portuguese azulejo tiles. The city brings together its French origins, Portuguese heritage and modern life as the capital of Maranhão state.
